name: Grim Finance GrimBoostVault depositFor reentrancy
summary: GrimBoostVault.depositFor(token, amount, user) took the deposit token as a caller-supplied parameter and minted shares around an unguarded external transferFrom call, so the attacker passed its own contract as the token and re-entered depositFor from that callback, minting eight tranches of vault shares against a single SpiritSwap BTC/WFTM LP deposit before burning them all in withdrawAll to drain the vault.
notes: Direct deployment of the GrimBoostVault runtime executed in the exploit.

The $30 million figure is the rounded aggregate loss across Grim Finance vaults affected by the same depositFor reentrancy campaign. Rekt reports approximately $30 million and Beefy's incident report estimates $32 million; this record uses the conservative rounded estimate.
Published reports round the campaign-wide loss to approximately $30 million or $32 million; the record uses the conservative $30 million estimate.
